description: Vélo en libre-service du STAR au standard GBFS is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by STAR. Publication des informations du vélo en libre-service du STAR au standard GBFS. Les caractéristiques de ce standard sont disponibles sur Les informations transmises dans ce standard sont des données publiées en temps réel (ou assimilé temps réel) provenant du système d’exploitation du vélo en libre-service du STAR. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are vélo, vélostar, emplacements, arceaux, stations, disponibilité. The portal shows 10 records. The portal shows 2019-05-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
